intro.text: Sarene's uncle, once a roving sailor, now a wealthy merchant in Kae who lives with his wife Daora and their children and cooks the family's meals himself.
Sarene's uncle and King Eventeo's elder brother, the rightful heir to Teod's throne. Once the pirate Dreok Crushthroat, he settled in Kae as a merchant and family man.

items.text: As the elder son of Teod's king, Kiin spent his youth on voyages to distant ports while his younger brother Eventeo helped their sickly father hold court. Their father died during a crisis while Kiin was at sea, and Eventeo took the crown. When Kiin came home and demanded it, Eventeo refused and exiled him.

Kiin built a fleet out of pirates, mercenaries and Teo deserters. An accident crushed his throat and nearly killed him; afterwards he called himself Dreok and sailed on Teod, but Eventeo narrowly beat him and Kiin escaped to Arelon.

In Arelon Kiin married Daora. Besides their own two children, Kaise and Daorn, he raised Daora's sons Lukel and Adien as his own, and put his knowledge of foreign lands to work as a very successful merchant.
The servants' bloody uprising during the Reod horrified Kiin and Daora, and they never hired servants again. Kiin also kept turning down the noble title King Iadon offered him.

When his niece Sarene arrived in Arelon, Kiin greeted her, brought her home to dine with his family and offered her a room. With Lukel he explained Arelon's politics to her and introduced her to the nobles of Raoden's old circle.

When Dakhor monks struck Kae, Kiin and Lukel saved Sarene from one of them, and Kiin's axe proved deadly even against a monk. Back at the house, Sarene saw the Aon Reo cut into the axe, and Kiin owned up to being Dreok Crushthroat, insisting it was Eventeo who had taken his throne.
Monks seized Kiin and Sarene on his balcony. Kiin went on to hold off three monks at once before they overpowered him, and he was marched to Elantris with the rest of the prisoners.

appearance.text: Kiin is huge, very tall and broad, both heavy and powerfully muscled, with wide brown eyes that look ready to laugh. He wore a beard when young but shaved it after coming to Arelon, and his voice is a deep rasp.

personality.text: Known in his younger days as a dashing, adventurous sailor, Kiin dresses in exotic clothes and arrives with lavish presents for Eventeo's family.
A superb cook of many nations' dishes, Kiin makes his family's meals himself, which is unusual for a rich Arelene household. Since the Reod he is wary of servants.
